evidence.detail: The exact-v308 record stores AdventureBookTaskTargetType, a target id, primary/secondary task text, an int-pair array, current progress, goal progress and a completion boolean.
Its text formatter replaces the exact token '{prog}' with the current/goal progress pair.

AdventureBookInterface consumes the entry to select ITEM/NPC_HEAD/OBJ target rendering, choose incomplete/complete sprites from current-versus-goal/completion state, lay out one or two task lines, and materialize the entry's item-pair array.

candidates.note: Descriptive semantic recovery from exact-v308 Adventure Book task model behavior; original stripped source identifier is not claimed.
